description: Environment variables of the process. Every value is a string or `undefined`: convert, default with `??` and validate at startup.
Validate configuration when the process starts and exit with a clear error, instead of failing later inside a request.
Command-line arguments as strings: `[node binary, script path, ...your arguments]`. Use `process.argv.slice(2)`.
Built-in argument parser: typed options, short aliases, defaults, positionals and strict mode that rejects unknown flags.
Number the process reports to the shell, CI or orchestrator. `0` is success; `1` is a general error and `2` a usage error by convention.
`exitCode` sets the code and lets pending work finish; `exit()` stops immediately and can cut off output and cleanup.
`node --env-file=.env main.ts` loads a `.env` file without the `dotenv` package (Node 20.6+).
